Dialogs.Dialog: Together？ Hmm, I think I'll pass today.
Hehe, sure？ Maybe we could stop somewhere on the way？
I have somewhere to stop by today, sorry？
Heading home？ Want to go together？
Yeah, of course. But isn't there some other girl you'd rather go home with？
I'd like to go home together, but today's no good. Sorry？
Heading home？ Want to go together？
Sure？ If you can ask a little more cutely.
Hehe. That face just now was cute, so okay▼
Sorry, today's no good. But I won't forgive you if you don't ask again next time, okay？
Want me to walk you home？
How cheeky. But you're cute, so I'll let it slide. Hehe▼
Geez, so cheeky. I won't walk home with a boy like that.
Hehe, kidding. I have something to do today, sorry？
Yes, dear▼ ...Just kidding, is that no good？
Sorry, today's a bit... even though you went to the trouble of asking.
Heading home？ Want to go together？
Sure？ Will you protect me from bad guys properly？
Hehe, you're my boyfriend, after all？
If it weren't today, it'd be fine. Too bad.
You'll walk me home？ I'm happy. I'm lucky to have such a dependable boyfriend. Hehe▼
I have something to do today, so I can't. Next time.
Sure. I'm happy we can go home together.
Sorry, I have plans today. Bye.
Heading home？ Want to go together？
Very well. You're my boyfriend, so escort me properly, okay？
I have something to do today, so I can't... next time, okay？
You'll walk me home. Yes, gladly.
Sorry？ I have to go straight home today. See you.
I don't know. I'm going home...
Heading home？ Want to go together？
I'm not going home with you.
That's not it. Geez, think about your girlfriend properly.
If you want, why don't we walk home together？ How about it？
Sure. Then let's go home together.
I see. Then it's okay. Bye.
Hey, will you walk home with me？ You will, right？
Hehe, I thought you'd say that.
I see. Then I'll go home alone.
If you're going home now, how about we walk together？
Hehe. Then big sis will escort you▼
If you want, why don't we walk home together？ How about it？
Sure. Then let's go home together.
I see. Then it's okay. Bye.
Hey, will you walk home with me？ You will, right？
Sure. Then let's go home together.
Hehe, I thought you'd say that.
I see. Then I'll go home alone.
If you're going home now, how about we walk together？
Hehe. Then big sis will escort you▼
Good. I was waiting, want to go home together？
I see. I'd be happy if you went home with me next time. Bye.
When his girlfriend invites him to walk home, what does a boyfriend do？
Ah, so that's what you say. Today's fine, but next time, please？
Hey, do you want to go home together today？
Okay, I want to go home with you.
It can't be helped then. Maybe next time.
Actually, I was waiting for you. Want to go together？
Yeah, that's okay. Let's go together then.
Sorry. I'm in a hurry today, so going together is...
Hey. You're walking to school with me, right？
Yeah, that's okay. Let's go together then.
Sorry. I'm in a hurry today, so going together is...
Really？ Then I'll take my time.
Shall I take you to school？
Ah, I guess I'll take you up on that.
Sorry. I'm in a hurry today, so going together is...
Ah, really？ It can't be helped then.
Make sure you keep up, okay？
Do your best today too, okay？
